64914.title: ODI debut, run out first ball
64914.story: His first innings for India lasted one ball in Chattogram. Nobody remembers that part.

64939.title: 148 in Visakhapatnam
64939.story: Sent in at No. 3 against Pakistan, he made his first international hundred and announced himself to the country.

287862.title: A tie, then a bowl-out
287862.story: The World Twenty20 group game in Durban finished level. India won the bowl-out 3–0.

287879.story: Pakistan needed 13 from the last over and he gave the ball to Joginder Sharma. Misbah-ul-Haq's scoop went straight to Sreesanth at short fine leg, and India won the first World Twenty20.

291372.title: CB Series won in Australia
291372.story: India swept the best-of-three finals 2–0 to win the CB Series in Australia.

335983.story: Chennai Super Kings' first IPL match, at Mohali.

430883.title: Number one in Tests
430883.story: His hundred at the Brabourne Stadium set up an innings win that took India to No. 1 in the ICC Test rankings for the first time.

433605.title: World Cup semi-final vs Pakistan
433605.story: The Mohali semi-final, watched by both prime ministers, sent India to the final.

433606.title: World champions at Wankhede
433606.story: Chasing 275, he promoted himself above Yuvraj Singh at 114/3 and finished it with a six off Nuwan Kulasekara: India's first World Cup since 1983.

566948.story: A rain-shortened 20-over final. With England needing 20 from 18 balls, he gave the 18th over to Ishant Sharma, who took two wickets in two balls. India completed his set of all three ICC white-ball trophies.

598812.title: 224 in Chennai
598812.story: His only Test double hundred, against Australia at Chepauk: the highest Test score by an Indian wicketkeeper.

951353.title: The glove comes off
951353.story: Bangladesh needed two off the last ball in Bengaluru. He had taken off a glove, and he sprinted from behind the stumps to run out Mustafizur Rahman and win it by one run.

1136620.story: The comeback season after a two-year suspension ended with Shane Watson's 117* in the final and a third title.

1144528.title: Guptill's direct hit
1144528.story: Chasing 240 in the World Cup semi-final, he was run out by Martin Guptill's direct hit with India still in the hunt. It was his last international innings.

1254117.story: A fourth IPL title, built on Faf du Plessis's 86.

1370353.story: A fifth title, level with Mumbai Indians. Ravindra Jadeja hit the last two balls for six and four in a rain-reduced chase, and Dhoni lifted him off the ground.
